summary: Post-refactor regression + new-feature verification (Daily Progress Note, Invoice builder refinements, Forms Print/PDF). Backend: 132/132 pytest passed (added 6 new tests: daily note persists 8 fields, daily empty-content 400, invoice next-number MB-XXXX format, next-number increments after create, invoice total = sum(qty*amount), invoice status allowlist). Frontend Playwright: 3-way note toggle (Free/SOAP/Daily), all daily fields + content textarea + Print/Save-PDF buttons visible; daily note saved -> 'Daily Progress Note' badge on card. Invoice builder: auto MB-0035 number, all 9 visit reason options exactly matching spec, units=3 -> minutes=45 auto + read-only, CPT auto-fills price ($20) and total updates to $60 (3×20), save persists to Saved Invoices list, Print/Save-PDF present. Forms responses viewer: modal shows letterhead (clinic name, tagline, address, phone, email) + form fields + signature + Print + Save-as-PDF buttons.

issues: Selecting patient did not auto-fill DOB in test (patient may not have DOB set). Not a bug: contingent on patient record having dob/gender values. Manual verification with a patient carrying dob recommended.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/notes.py: content required-check runs AFTER SOAP-build fallback, so a daily note with note_type='daily' but no content string returns 400 (verified in tests). Consider surfacing structured field-set validity for daily notes too (currently only 'content' is required).

backend/routers/billing.py: /invoices/next-number uses count_documents({}) which is race-prone under concurrent creates (two parallel POSTs could get the same MB-XXXX). Consider a Mongo counters collection with $inc for atomicity if concurrent billing is expected.
backend/routers/billing.py: invoice item quantity has no minimum guard (negative qty would produce negative total). Add Pydantic Field(ge=1) on InvoiceItem.quantity and amount>=0 for safety.

backend/routers/notes.py: LlmChat model is hardcoded to 'gpt-5.4' — if quota-exhausted the endpoint returns 500 with raw exception message which may leak internal details; consider a fixed sanitized message.

server.py is now cleanly split into per-resource routers under /app/backend/routers plus /app/backend/core, /app/backend/models, /app/backend/data — good refactor. 48 routes all import cleanly and every pre-refactor test still passes (RBAC, auth, forms, invoices, notes, settings, brute-force lockout, minimization of /users for non-admins).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Daily Note, Invoice builder, Forms responses flows verified end-to-end)

test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md - admin, doctor, nurse, psych, receptionist, biller
seed_data_creation: Playwright created 1 TEST_UI_Daily progress note and 1 invoice MB-0035 during UI verification. Both remain (non-destructive). All pytest TEST_* patients cleaned up by tests.

Daily note type persists 8 extra fields (dob, gender, ssn, visit_date, reason_for_visit, attending_provider, referring_provider, icd10) via NoteInput schema. Invoice builder computes total server-side (sum of amount*quantity) and issues MB-000N via count-based next-number (see race note). All 132 backend tests + full UI regression passing.
